title: Start a call from the browser.
description: SparkCall gives you a browser-based place to use a SparkCall number, reach a contact, and manage a voice call without installing a native app.

browser.title: WebRTC audio
browser.detail: Calls use your browser microphone and WebRTC. Depending on the connection, audio may use a configured TURN relay.

temporary.title: Temporary access
temporary.detail: Temporary identities expire after {{lifetimeHours}} hours. Microphone permission and a working call configuration are required.

errors.temporaryAccount: Could not create a temporary session. {{detail}}
